lines: It's just a fragile life.
Your eyes that speak wavered.
Time passes gently yet surely.
I am recording the empty days.
Even if I hold your frozen hand.
The dry cough never ceased.
Even when tomorrow is unseen.
I'll shine, so don't fade away yet.
The voice waiting for spring flutters, echoing and dancing through the void.
Like white snow, like a flower, merely fleeting.
Within the melting time.
If the warmth we shared cools.
That you.
The spring breeze will snatch you.
It's only a brief parting.
You said with a forced smile.
A breath about to break now turns pale.
I grasp the withered hand.
Strength becomes fragile.
I wish this room alone could stop time.
Soon I will be unable to walk.
You will lose the ability to speak and disappear, won't you.
That single life will surely circle around.
Each time we meet, we fall in love the same way.
Laughing, "How romantic,"
Within a faded film.
The two of us standing side by side
Turn transparent.
When I wake in the morning
Everything is just a dream.
If you were laughing beside me.
Even that wish fades away with the snow.
The scent of spring arrives.
You aren't here in this blossoming season.
The voice waiting for spring flutters, echoing and dancing through the void.
Like white snow, like a flower, merely fleeting.
Within the melting time.
If the warmth we shared cools.
That you.
The spring breeze will snatch you.
